text: So efficient great hospital very happy with the service provided.
Friendly and Helpful staff, well trained, a bit of a wait, but worth it when you pay the bill! Recommended!

I would like to suggest that the staff provide more detailed and accurate instructions on how to receive medication. The staff at the front desk told me to place the slip in front of the pharmacy, but they didn't specify which slip it was. This was my first time, and I didn't know which one to put in. I waited for a very long time, so I got up to ask. That's when I found out it was a different slip. The pharmacy staff should have called me over to ask when they saw I had placed the wrong slip, instead of just throwing it away. People were left waiting. Please improve this process.

text: If you think you're not ready to treat all illnesses, you shouldn't offer medical services. I asked the doctor if they had artificial tears, and he said no, I should buy them outside. If you don't have a complete range of medications to treat every illness, the hospital shouldn't offer comprehensive medical care. It's supposed to be 30 baht for all illnesses, but if the hospital doesn't have the medications for every disease, they shouldn't be offering universal treatment. But the hospital staff said they do have them. So why did the doctor say that?

text: For newcomers, please bring your ID card to room number 1 for the medical history taking process. It's best to arrive early, as by 7:30 AM the queue is already over 20. They will then take your medical history to determine your condition, and you will register for a hospital card at rooms number 2 and 3. After receiving your nurse's card, you will be directed to table number 2 to have your blood pressure measured, then you will be examined by the doctor. Next, you will go to table number 3 for a more detailed medical history taking session, which will be one-on-one. After that, you will wait at table number 4 to receive your medication. It's recommended to bring a cloth bag to carry your medication.

With your permission, I would like to personally express my sincere appreciation to the nurses on the 5th floor. They provided excellent advice and consultation. Communication and details were very clear. Thank you very much to all the nurses.

I came to pick up medicine for my mother. The service was excellent.
The security guard was polite and provided good service. There is limited parking space.

My mother was admitted to the ICU on the 3rd floor.
She's undergoing NG tube feeding. During the evening visit, I found BD stains on the bedsheets and numerous ants on the patient's bed.
Please take care of hygiene and cleanliness.

I called to inquire about information with the registration counter on the evening of July 16, 2025. I spoke politely, wanting confirmation of my information, but the female officer who answered the phone raised her voice and yelled. Such poor manners and behavior in a customer service role reflect poorly on the organization. She needs to improve her attitude and manners. I recommend sending her for attitude adjustment training immediately, or she may have a mental health issue and should seek treatment. Her emotional state was clearly poor.
Consult via Line. The admin is very polite and provides detailed information.

The hospital is great, and all the staff provide excellent service.
***
Except for one woman at the new card counter, window 2, who wasn't wearing glasses. She was being rude and yelling at me. Why did you ask me so nicely?

There are highly skilled doctors available for treatment. My parents received excellent diagnosis and care from Dr. Wasan and Dr. Wasin.

The hospital also provides excellent assistance with transporting patients who require wheelchairs. There's a mobile beverage service (like a turtle-shaped vending machine) and a coffee shop at the front of the building.

Registration for patients involves swiping your national ID card into the system.
If you've never been here before, you need to register and get a new ID card. Some staff members are polite, while others are stern, but overall, over 90% are very courteous.

The referral process is well-organized.
Weight and height measurements are performed using good equipment, and blood pressure measurements are assisted by staff. For healthy patients who can move around easily, blood pressure can be measured directly by swiping the ID card. All information is entered into the hospital's CM Nyeoro app, which allows you to access your medical history, medication records, and doctor's appointments by entering your patient ID.

There's a well-organized process for taking medical history and referring patients to doctors in a structured manner.
The waiting area is spacious and comfortable, with some areas offering free herbal drinks.
There are convenient monitors for viewing the queue, and staff members address patients by name with excellent professionalism.

The doctors provide excellent treatment and medication.
The pharmacist meticulously inquired about medication use.

Patients with a universal healthcare card (Gold Card) are eligible for treatment.
Normal treatment doesn't incur excessive costs.

There are small restaurants behind the building where you can sit and eat.
The central restaurant serves delicious Thai curry and à la carte dishes.
Snacks, instant coffee, fruit, and packaged crackers are also available for sale.

The queues for payment and medication are very well-organized.
The staff works efficiently.

In front of the hospital, there is a shady garden.
There are statues of Buddha, Luang Pu Doo, Brahma, and a local shrine for worship.
There is a pond with a statue of Phra Mae Thorani (Mother Earth) wringing her hair.

Parking is usually empty in the afternoon and evening.
Weekday mornings are quite crowded.

This hospital has left a very positive impression on me.

At the information counter where new registrations are processed, in the glass-walled room, the female employee spoke rudely, raised her voice, and had a nasty, angry expression. I suggest they change staff or take a customer service etiquette course.
Parking for cars is limited, so locals should come by motorcycle if possible.

The staff, nurses, and doctors are lovely and speak politely. Everyone provides excellent service and is attentive to patients. The doctor even greets patients with a respectful bow first. I wish all hospital staff provided service like at this psychiatric hospital; that would be wonderful.

The service was excellent. The medical team, nurses, and assistants were very skilled. I'm so glad I chose to receive treatment here. However, I would like to suggest installing CCTV cameras on the general ward balcony. We have many relatives who tend to store a lot of belongings there. We were robbed! 🤣🙏🏻 …
I must commend the staff; the place is clean and the doctors, nurses, and personnel provided excellent care. Thank you.

I am Captain Chulapon Yaem-Amphol, a patient at Chiang Mai Psychiatric Hospital, suffering from osteoporosis.
What impressed me most was the overall experience I had to deal with. From the security guard, the staff at the registration desk, the nurses who did the screening, the staff who managed the queues for examinations, to the doctors who continued seeing patients even after noon—they would see everyone before taking a break for lunch. The pharmacy was open 24/7.
I've been to the physical therapy room for almost a year now and have found that they are very attentive and caring towards all patients. Whenever I have questions or inquiries, they answer them with care and enthusiasm.
This has made me completely forget that it's a bureaucratic system where you have to wait a long time and encounter rude people.
That's not the case at all at the psychiatric hospital. I am truly impressed.

To try the test, you have to come early in the morning. There are quite a few people. Submit your ID card, register your history, and wait to have your blood pressure and weight measured. The officer will take you as a group to another building for the test. The nurse will explain the test process very well, but she also talked a bit too much about cannabis and other things. Patients who come for the test want to finish quickly and want them to understand, but talking about other things for a long time like this shouldn't be done. Parking is limited. You have to come early, but you can park in the building next to Suan Dok.

The doctors, nurses, lab staff, and all other personnel provided excellent service. In particular, the registration and MRI appointment booking area, which was closed for renovations (we had to sit outside in the heat), was still incredibly helpful, cheerful, and dedicated. Thank you so much! 🙏🏻 …

I am dissatisfied with the service. The nurse conducting the screening was rude. While waiting in line, the entire hospital suddenly stopped operations to listen to a student or someone giving a presentation. It should have been organized …

Some nurses are completely irresponsible.
#The male doctor caring for COVID patients speaks poorly, provides no details to patients, and doesn't explain the patients' symptoms at all.
Sometimes, when asking for medication from certain nurses, it takes forever to get it—ask in the morning, get it in the evening. Even when I explain my symptoms, they ignore me, saying I have a high fever and just tell me to go shower and take medicine. This has been going on for a week now.
#Show some interest! Just because they signed consent forms for treatment doesn't mean they want to die.

The service is up to standard, the health advice is excellent, and the specialized neurology services are top-notch. If you have a neurological illness and need treatment, I highly recommend them.
